visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a white chef's jacket stands centered in front of a light gray brick wall in a brightly lit studio setting. To his right, several product boxes and kitchenware items are neatly displayed on shelves. He looks directly at the camera and gestures with his hands while speaking. Bold text overlays appear at the top and bottom of the frame, showing brand logos and promotional slogans. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up product shot where a hand carefully places a large, round white ceramic griddle plate onto a sleek, cream-colored circular IH heater base. The background is a clean kitchen counter. The lighting is soft and professional, emphasizing the smooth textures of the kitchen appliances. (3) A detailed close-up shows the touch control panel of the heater. A human finger presses the digital buttons to demonstrate the interface. A bright red digital display shows the number 6, and various icons for timer and heat settings are visible. The framing is tight on the device. (4) A montage of visual phases shows cooking demonstrations: top-down shots of salmon searing on the griddle with steam rising, stir-frying eggplant in a deep pan, and a pot of meat simmering. Each shot features vibrant food colors and high-contrast lighting. (5) The chef reappears in a medium shot, holding one of the white plates and smiling at the camera. He continues to explain the product benefits. Large text overlays displaying pricing and a discount code appear over the lower half of the screen, while the background remains the studio setup.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic and friendly male voice delivering a professional pitch in Mandarin Chinese. He is accompanied by high-tempo, upbeat pop-electronic background music with a strong synth-driven beat. The vocal tone is inviting and highly positive. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narrator describes the sleek design of the IH heater. The music remains consistently active, providing a rhythmic background that maintains the fast editing pace. No environmental noise is present, indicating a studio environment. (3) A distinct electronic 'beep' sound effect plays when the UI touch panel is shown, synchronized with the narration. The speaker's pitch variability is high, emphasizing key product features with an excited inflection. (4) Soft sizzling and liquid sounds are audible under the voice as cooking is demonstrated, providing realistic acoustic textures to the food scenes. The BGM maintains its driving rhythm without pauses. (5) A final 'ding' chime sounds to highlight the discount code at the end of the video. The speaker's arousal level stays high until the final second, ending the track with a confident call to action as the music fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Technical Specs -> Usage Scenarios -> Pricing/Promo -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a high-energy commercial for a co-branded IH cooking heater between 'Great Chef' and 'récolte' for Mother's Day. It uses a professional chef narrator and fast-paced editing to showcase the product's aesthetic design, technical features like IR technology and safety sensors, and culinary versatility through a montage of dishes. The strategic use of a limited-time discount code 'cook123' and official website call-to-action aims to drive immediate sales conversions.
